description: This file defines a PHP class 'Cheque' as part of the OpenCart e-commerce platform. The class handles the display and confirmation logic for cheque payments through the extension system. It includes methods to load language data, generate a payment information view, and confirm an order with cheque details, updating order status and redirecting as appropriate.

classes.name: Cheque
classes.description: Controller class for handling cheque payment method in OpenCart, including displaying payment info and confirming payment orders.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language data, prepares view data with payable and address info, and returns the cheque payment view.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Validates order and payment method, adds order history with cheque details, and redirects to success or failure pages via JSON response.
